licence.scope: ESA Science Data Centre terms for the ESA Space Science Archives, level 2 (owner's data terms), applied by analogy: IUE is not in the page's credit-line table and no statement names the IUE camera sensitivity curve. The IUE page SVO cites (http://sci.esa.int/iue/ -> https://sci.esa.int/web/iue/) has only the site-wide Terms and Conditions link (non-commercial personal use, https://sci.esa.int/terms-and-conditions) and no data terms. Non-commercial (CC BY-NC) with commercial use needing ESA authorisation, hence attribution, as in GAIA__GAIA; no IUE credit line is given in the credit table, so no acknowledgement is recorded. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
